name: release-cut-reminder
description: Advisory-only (never blocks) reminder printed on git push once commits-since-last-tag reaches a small threshold (default 6, override via RELEASE_CUT_REMINDER_THRESHOLD env var). Direct response to a real gap: this repository's own version tags once fell 90 commits behind before anyone noticed. Fires every push past the threshold rather than escalating -- whether a given push is actually a good moment to cut a release is a judgment call the script cannot make; 'not yet, still mid-batch' is a valid response. Degrades silently on a repo with no tags yet.
